children.name: TranCodesList
children.description: get or set TranCodes

children.name: LogicModule
children.description: Logic module Valid Values:o-9 Format:XX Example:40 Allowable Values: 5

children.name: TransactionCode
children.description: The unique, user-defined number assigned to the transaction Valid Values: 0-9,A-z Example: 1360 = Bad Debit settlement Allowable Values: 20

children.name: TransactionType
children.description: Display if it is Debit or Credit transaction. Valid Values: - Debit - Credit Example: Debit Allowable Values: 100

children.name: TransactionDescription
children.description: Description of the transaction code. Valid Values: 0-9, A-Z Example: Bad Debit settlement Allowable Values: 80

children.name: ShortDescription
children.description: A short description that can be used for reporting, messaging or any other reason Example: PLAN TXFR - DR Allowable Values: 30

children.name: SendToLedger
children.description: Indicates which posted transactions should be included in the outgoing ledger file. Valid Values: - Yes - No - Send A/R Only - Send P/L Only Allowable Values: 100

children.name: Commission
children.description: Indicates if the transaction is eligible for commissions Valid Values: Yes and No Allowable Values: 100

children.name: AccountReceivableDebitLedger
children.description: The debit ledger accounts the system should send to the General Ledger when the transaction code posts to a non-charged off account. If the Send to Ledger field is set to Yes or Send A/R Only, a value in this field is made. If the Send to Ledger field is set to No or Send P/L Only, any entry in this field is ignored. Allowable Values: 19

children.name: AccountReceivableCreditLedger
children.description: The credit ledger accounts the system should send to the General Ledger when the transaction code posts to a non-charged off account. If the Send to Ledger field is set to Yes or Send A/R Only, a value in this field is made. If the Send to Ledger field is set to No or Send P/L Only, any entry in this field is ignored. Allowable Values: 19

children.name: ProfitLossDebitLedger
children.description: The Profit and Loss Debit Ledger provided to the Transaction Code. If the Send to Ledger field is set to Yes or Send P/L Only, a value in this field is made. If the Send to Ledger field is set to No or Send A/R Only, any entry in this field is ignored. Allowable Values: 19

children.name: ProfitLossCreditLedger
children.description: The Profit and Loss Credit Ledger provided to the Transaction Code. If the Send to Ledger field is set to Yes or Send P/L Only, a value in this field is made. If the Send to Ledger field is set to No or Send A/R Only, any entry in this field is ignored. Allowable Values: 19

children.name: BackdatedMethod
children.description: Indicates the method to post backdated transactions using this transaction code. Valid Values: 0 = Post all back-dated transactions 1 = Change date to posting date 2 = Post to exception Account 3 = Calculated as prior year-end minus backdate days 4 = Calculated as current date minus backdate days 5 = Post all back-dated transactions except across cycles Allowable Values: 100

children.name: BackdatedDays
children.description: The values are 1 through 120. If set to 1, any transaction coming in through an external source (interface, association, web, etc.) or through the online panels are allowed to post if the effective date is equal to the prior day’s date. If set to 2, any transaction coming in through an external source or through the online panels are allowed to post if the effective date is equal to the date of the prior 2 days. The restriction of 120 days only applies to automatic backdating of original transactions. You still have the ability to manage transactions in standard dispute / chargeback processing timeframes. Allowable Values: 3

children.name: FuturedatedMethod
children.description: Indicates the method used to post future-dated transactions using this transaction code. Valid Values: - Post all future-dated transactions - Change date to posting date - Post to exception Account Allowable Values: 100

children.name: FuturedatedDays
children.description: The values are 1 through 30. If set to 1, any transaction coming in through an external source (interface, association, web, etc.) or through the online panels are placed in the warehouse file if the effective date is equal to tomorrow’s date. If set to 2, any transaction coming in through an external source or through the online panels are placed in the warehouse file if the effective date is equal to tomorrow’s date or the following day’s date. When a transaction is received with a future date greater than 30 days before today’s date, the system rejects the transaction so it can be manually worked via the Monetary Batch panels Valid Values: 1-30 Allowable Values: 3

children.name: MTCStatus
children.description: Status of MTC. Active or Inactive Valid Values: Active and Inactive Example: Active Allowable Values: 100

children.name: TransactionCodeType
children.description: Type of Transaction code. Valid Values: Gen Int Fee Allowable Values: 100

children.name: IncludeInStatementTotals
children.description: Indicates if the transaction should update year-to-date totals. This field is enabled only for transaction codes with a Transaction code type of INT or FEE. Valid Values: - YTD Totals Only - Both YTD and CTD Totals - Neither YTD or CTD Totals Allowable Values: 100

children.name: AchPushOption
children.description: Indicates No,ye,Yes, with no ACH push. This Ach Push Options. Valid Values: - Yes - No - with no ACH push Allowable Values: 100
